# SigRepo 1.1.0
* Documentation: https://montilab.github.io/SigRepo/
* GitHub: https://github.com/montilab/SigRepo/
* Uni-directional signatures may omit scores: the four `add*SignatureSet()` functions no longer require a non-empty `score`, which is stored as NULL and comes back as NA. `addSignature()` now rolls back and errors if the feature step stored no rows, instead of returning a signature id for an empty signature. Needs OmicSignature >= 1.4.1, which keeps NA-score rows (#258, montilab/SigRepo_Server#89).
* `searchSignature()` now finds partial matches and can filter on more of the columns it returns: a term that is some value in full matches only that value, otherwise it matches every value containing it, so `signature_name = "M005"` finds `LC_M005_liver`. Blank and NA terms are ignored instead of matching everything (#230, #231).
* `addUser()` and `updateUser()` now grant privileges on the database the connection is on instead of a hard-coded `sigrepo` schema, and `checkDBTable()` reads `SHOW TABLES` by position, so seeding and lookups work on a database with any name (#245, montilab/SigRepo_Server#130).
* Breaking: the signature-type and platform fields follow the server's renamed schema. The `direction_types` data object is now `signature_types` and `checkDirectionType()` is now `checkSignatureType()`; the `platform_name` argument of `searchSignature()`, `searchPlatform()` and `deletePlatform()`, and the `platform_name` input column of `addPlatform()`, are now `platform`, with no deprecated alias. Metadata is read and written as `type` and `platform`, so `getSignature()` and `createOmicCollection()` no longer silently drop a signature's platform. Needs OmicSignature >= 1.4.0 (#242).
* `updateSignature()` is limited to the signature's owner or an admin, checked before anything changes, so a shared editor can no longer leave a signature with no features or access rows. A failed update now restores the users and collections the signature was shared with (#214, #215).
* `compareSignatures()` ranks by the `pvalue` column when a ranking signature has no `p_value`, and by `adj_p` with a warning when it has neither, for `ks_rank`, `ks_score` and `gsea` (#212).
* Client fixes: feature-name searches in `searchProteomicsFeatureSet()` and `searchGeneticVariantsFeatureSet()` return `organism_id`; `updateSignature()` and `addSignatureWithID()` upload the difexp again; `checkTableInput()` replaces every missing value and fills a missing uni-directional `group_label` with "All Features"; `createOmicSignature()` takes the difexp's `feature_name` spelling when it differs from the reference only in case; connections are closed on error paths too (#202-#209).
* Lookups use the database indexes while matching exactly as before, which makes `getSignature()` and other reads much faster (#200).
